title: Windowed Integrator
text: Block DC component, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Algorithm for estimating DC offset} sets Algorithm for estimating DC offset; {Normalized bandwidth of lowpass IIR or CIC filter}, {Order of lowpass IIR elliptic filter}, {Number of past input samples for FIR algorithm}, {View Filter Response} sets the visualize frequency response and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Output signal with no DC component scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Algorithm for estimating DC offset
params.values: Algorithm for estimating DC offset IIR (default) | FIR | CIC | Subtract mean

params.name: Normalized bandwidth of lowpass IIR or CIC filter
params.values: Normalized bandwidth 0.001 (default) | real scalar in the range (0 1)

params.name: Order of lowpass IIR elliptic filter
params.values: Order of lowpass IIR elliptic filter 6 (default) | integer greater than 3

params.name: Number of past input samples for FIR algorithm
params.values: Number of past input samples for FIR algorithm 50 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
